nieuw.titel: Risk a cleanup shot to keep your main threat moving
nieuw.tekst: When keeping a major threat on a flank would waste another turn while the centre is losing, consider moving it on and leaving a weaker unit to attempt the cleanup. He recommends taking that chance when the potential gain in tempo is worth the poor odds.
nieuw.waarom: He felt that delaying further favoured his opponent: the enemy Wyvern could act elsewhere and the Boar Boyz were cutting through the rest of his army.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He flew his Bloodthirster onwards rather than attacking a one-wound chariot and ending up behind impassable terrain. He left 15 Pink Horrors to try to shoot off the last wound despite their poor odds, and they succeeded.

bronnen.citaat: Sometimes you just got to try to roll the six.

extraCitaten.citaat: because of tempo, I got to do something about it.
having the blood thirst to do something more efficient in the interim

nieuw.titel: Reform Pink Horrors into a line to shoot
nieuw.tekst: Use an Open Order reform to put Pink Horrors into a line while keeping the centre model in place, allowing them all to shoot. After the shooting opportunity, they can reform back into a rectangular formation.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that they can all still shoot after reforming, and their Quick Shots avoid the shooting penalty for moving.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He used this reform when his Pink Horrors attempted to remove the last wound from a chariot, allowing his Bloodthirster to move on.
